model_output.score_comment_short: Recent roles combine extensive operating responsibility with specific results and methods.
model_output.score_comment_long: The COO section connects practice growth, integration, retention, and margin to concrete figures. A few executive responsibilities could explain more about the decisions behind them. Adding that detail selectively would make an already detailed record easier to assess.
model_output.score_plain: The resume gives a reviewer substantial information for assessing senior healthcare operations roles. A few targeted additions could help distinguish how you work at the executive level.
model_output.first_impression: Your current role spans 140 practices across 9 states, with CEO and board access stated upfront. The operating results are easy to find, though some executive decisions behind them remain less visible.
model_output.biggest_gap_example: "Led the Epic go-live across the clinics in 2013" does not explain the rollout decisions you handled, leaving your contribution to the implementation less distinct.
model_output.summary: Growing the dental organization from 38 to 140 practices sits alongside a rise in same-store EBITDA margin from 17% to 23%. That pairing is worth keeping because it shows growth and performance at the same time without needing to claim one caused the other. Your COO role also shows responsibility for integration, clinical retention, and a large operating model. The record reads at the COO level, although the subjects you bring to the board are not specified, which leaves your executive reporting less concrete.
strengths: Reducing integration time from 7 months to 10 weeks through a standardized playbook shows how you changed the process.
The compensation plan and clinical career ladder are linked to a drop in hygienist turnover from 34% to 19% over two years.
The surgery center turnaround names both payer contract renegotiation and block scheduling, making the financial change easier to understand.
gaps: The quarterly board presentations have no stated topics, so a reviewer cannot tell which operating questions you bring to directors.
Your sponsorship of the EHR consolidation does not describe the decisions you made during the transition.
The value-based contract shift states the covered population and group savings, but not which parts of the transition you directed.

top_fixes.fix: In the COO board-reporting bullet, name the operating or financial topics you presented, if you can verify them.
top_fixes.why: The reporting relationship is clear, but the subjects would show what the board relied on you to explain.
